messages.author: 3fd30254cc2deeb1
messages.subject: specifying prior density functions
parts: Hi, as I read from the mirt R package, normal (gaussian) distribution is used default for the bayesian estimation. Is it possible to specify different prior density functions for the bayesian ability estimates?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: specifying prior density functions
parts:
I assume you are referring to the fscores() function? Yes, see the documentation. You can supply a function to the argument custom_den to use whatever density you want. There's examples of this in the helpfile and on the wiki.

Phil
